mapper.select: select pgfd.id, q.dates, q.pkg, q.user_type, q.total_user_num, q.total_record_count, q.pass_record_count, q.fail_record_count, q.game_total_time, q.total_grant, q.total_consumption FROM (select dugr.dates, dugr.pkg, 0 user_type, COUNT(DISTINCT dugr.user_id) total_user_num, COUNT(1) total_record_count, SUM(IF(dugr.game_status = 1, 1, 0)) pass_record_count, SUM(IF(dugr.game_status = 0, 1, 0)) fail_record_count, SUM(dugr.game_time) game_total_time, SUM(IF(dugr.reward_consumption_type = 1, dugr.reward_consumption_amount, 0)) total_grant, SUM(IF(dugr.reward_consumption_type = 0, dugr.reward_consumption_amount, 0)) total_consumption from dwd_user_game_record dugr WHERE dugr.dates = #{dates} group by dugr.dates, dugr.pkg) q LEFT JOIN dws_pkg_game_full_daily pgfd ON (pgfd.dates = q.dates and pgfd.pkg = q.pkg and pgfd.user_type = q.user_type)

select pgfd.id, q.dates, q.pkg, q.user_type, q.total_user_num, q.total_record_count, q.pass_record_count, q.fail_record_count, q.game_total_time, q.total_grant, q.total_consumption FROM (select dugr.dates, dugr.pkg, 1 user_type, COUNT(DISTINCT dugr.user_id) total_user_num, COUNT(1) total_record_count, SUM(IF(dugr.game_status = 1, 1, 0)) pass_record_count, SUM(IF(dugr.game_status = 0, 1, 0)) fail_record_count, SUM(dugr.game_time) game_total_time, SUM(IF(dugr.reward_consumption_type = 1, dugr.reward_consumption_amount, 0)) total_grant, SUM(IF(dugr.reward_consumption_type = 0, dugr.reward_consumption_amount, 0)) total_consumption from dwd_user_game_record dugr INNER JOIN dim_user_info dui ON (dui.user_id = dugr.user_id AND dui.dates = dugr.dates) WHERE dugr.dates = #{dates} group by dugr.dates, dugr.pkg) q LEFT JOIN dws_pkg_game_full_daily pgfd ON (pgfd.dates = q.dates and pgfd.pkg = q.pkg and pgfd.user_type = q.user_type)
